newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat mostly weaker, spread trading feature.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat mostly weaker, spread trading feature.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures were mostly lower early as spread dealings dominated Tuesday's session, traders said.

"Our feature is the December/March spread which has widened out back a bit," a trader said. "We started at 16, traded at 17, 17-1/2, 18 and then five lots traded at 19 and a five-lot trade at 20 cents a bushel. Now we are at 18-1/2-19 cents."
He noted that LFG was chasing the December contract. On the fundamental side, there was nothing new "that I am aware of," he added.
But "I think we can still sell rallies in wheat," the trader said.
At 1019 CST, KCBT December wheat firmed one cent to $4.00-1/2 a bushel while March lost 1-1/4 cent to ask at $3.82.
